Summing up over tt and rearranging, set α=1/I\alpha=1/I, we have:

1T​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐯t−∏i=1K∇fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\displaystyle\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{v}_{t}-\prod_{i=1}^{K}\nabla f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α​KB1​T​LJ2​Lf2​K−2​∑i=1K∑t=1T‖𝐮τi−1−𝐮t+1i−1‖2+2​Kα​B1​T​LJ2​Lf2​K−2​∑i=1K∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]\displaystyle 2\alpha\frac{K}{B_{1}T}L_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{\tau}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}+\frac{2K}{\alpha B_{1}T}L_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α​KB1​T​LJ2​Lf2​K−2​∑i=1K∑t=1T‖∑j=τt𝐮ji−1−𝐮j+1i−1‖2+2​Kα​B1​T​LJ2​Lf2​K−2​∑i=1K∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]\displaystyle 2\alpha\frac{K}{B_{1}T}L_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\sum_{j=\tau}^{t}\mathbf{u}_{j}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{j+1}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}+\frac{2K}{\alpha B_{1}T}L_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α​K​I2B1​T​LJ2​Lf2​K−2​∑i=1K∑t=1T‖𝐮ti−1−𝐮t+1i−1‖2+2​Kα​B1​T​LJ2​Lf2​K−2​∑i=1K∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]\displaystyle 2\alpha\frac{KI^{2}}{B_{1}T}L_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}+\frac{2K}{\alpha B_{1}T}L_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 4​Kα​B1​T​LJ2​Lf2​K−2​∑i=1K∑t=1T‖𝐮ti−1−𝐮t+1i−1‖2.\displaystyle\frac{4K}{\alpha B_{1}T}L_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}.

∎

Next, we bound the estimation error of the function value estimator in the following lemma.

Lemma 22.
1T​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]≤4​Lf2α​B1​T​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2].\displaystyle\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]\leq\frac{4L_{f}^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right].
Proof.

Following the very similar analysis, we have:

𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq (1−α)2​𝔼​‖𝐮t−1i−fi​(𝐮t−1i−1)‖2+2​α2​𝔼​[‖𝐡ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\displaystyle(1-\alpha)^{2}\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t-1}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t-1}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}+{2\alpha^{2}}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{h}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]
+2​(1−α)2​𝔼​[‖1B1​∑j=1B1(fi​(𝐮t−1i−1,ξti,j)−fi​(𝐮ti−1,ξti,j)−fi​(𝐮t−1i−1)+fi​(𝐮ti−1))‖2]\displaystyle\qquad+2(1-\alpha)^{2}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\frac{1}{B_{1}}\sum_{j=1}^{B_{1}}\left(f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t-1}^{i-1};\xi_{t}^{i,j})-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1};\xi_{t}^{i,j})-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t-1}^{i-1})+f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right)\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq (1−α)​𝔼​‖𝐮t−1i−fi​(𝐮t−1i−1)‖2+2​α2​Lf2B1​‖𝐮τi−1−𝐮ti−1‖2+2​Lf2B1​‖𝐮t−1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2.\displaystyle(1-\alpha)\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t-1}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t-1}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}+\frac{2\alpha^{2}L_{f}^{2}}{B_{1}}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{\tau}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}+\frac{2L_{f}^{2}}{B_{1}}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t-1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}.

This leads to the fact that:

1T​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\displaystyle\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α​Lf2B1​T​∑t=1T∑i=1K‖𝐮τi−1−𝐮t+1i−1‖2+2​Lf2α​B1​T​∑t=1T∑i=1K‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2\displaystyle\frac{2\alpha L_{f}^{2}}{B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{\tau}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}+\frac{2L_{f}^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α​Lf2​I2B1​T​∑t=1T∑i=1K‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2+2​Lf2α​B1​T​∑t=1T∑i=1K‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2\displaystyle\frac{2\alpha L_{f}^{2}I^{2}}{B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}+\frac{2L_{f}^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq 4​Lf2α​B1​T​∑t=1T∑i=1K‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2.\displaystyle\frac{4L_{f}^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}.

By summing up and rearranging, we finish the proof of this lemma. ∎

Then, we bound the term ∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right].

Lemma 23.

We can obtain the following guarantee.

∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq (∑i=1K(4​Lf2)i−1)​(∑t=1T𝔼⁡[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]+2​α2​K​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]).\displaystyle\left(\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{i-1}\right)\left(\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]+2\alpha^{2}K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]\right).
Proof.

(1) For the first level, i.e., i=1i=1, we have:

∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]=∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐱t+1−𝐱t‖2]=∑t=1T𝔼⁡[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2].\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{x}_{t+1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right].

(2) For other levels, i.e., 2≤i≤K2\leq i\leq K, we have:

∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]
=\displaystyle= ∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖α⁡(𝐡t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1)+(1−α)B1​∑j=1B1(fi−1​(𝐮t+1i−2,ξt+1i−1,j)−fi−1​(𝐮ti−2,ξt+1i−1,j))‖2]\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\alpha\left(\mathbf{h}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right)+\frac{(1-\alpha)}{B_{1}}\sum_{j=1}^{B_{1}}(f_{i-1}(\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-2};\xi_{t+1}^{i-1,j})-f_{i-1}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2};\xi_{t+1}^{i-1,j}))\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α2​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖fi−1​(𝐮ti−2)−𝐮ti−1+𝐡t+1i−1−fi−1​(𝐮ti−2)‖2]+2​Lf2​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−2−𝐮ti−2‖2]\displaystyle 2\alpha^{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|f_{i-1}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2})-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}+\mathbf{h}_{t+1}^{i-1}-f_{i-1}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2})\right\|^{2}\right]+2L_{f}^{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-2}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2}\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α2​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖fi−1​(𝐮ti−2)−𝐮ti−1‖2]+2​α2​Lf2B1​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−2−𝐮τi−2‖2]\displaystyle 2\alpha^{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|f_{i-1}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2})-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]+\frac{2\alpha^{2}L_{f}^{2}}{B_{1}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-2}-\mathbf{u}_{\tau}^{i-2}\right\|^{2}\right]
+2Lf2∑t=1T𝔼[‖𝐮t+1i−2−𝐮ti−2‖2]\displaystyle\quad+2L_{f}^{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-2}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2}\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​α2​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖fi−1​(𝐮ti−2)−𝐮ti−1‖2]+4​Lf2​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−2−𝐮ti−2‖2].\displaystyle 2\alpha^{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|f_{i-1}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2})-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]+4L_{f}^{2}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-2}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-2}\right\|^{2}\right].

Denote that Υi=∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\Upsilon^{i}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right] and Qi=∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]Q^{i}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right], we have Qi≤4​Lf2​Qi−1+2​α2​Υi−1Q^{i}\leq 4L_{f}^{2}Q^{i-1}+2\alpha^{2}\Upsilon^{i-1} for i≥2i\geq 2. Then we can get:

Q1\displaystyle Q^{1} ≤𝔼⁡[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]\displaystyle\leq\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]
Q2\displaystyle Q^{2} ≤(4​Lf2)​𝔼​[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]+2​α2​Υt1\displaystyle\leq\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]+2\alpha^{2}\Upsilon_{t}^{1}
Q3\displaystyle Q^{3} ≤(4​Lf2)2​𝔼​[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]+2​α2​(4​Lf2​Υt1+Υt2)\displaystyle\leq\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{2}\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]+2\alpha^{2}\left(4L_{f}^{2}\Upsilon_{t}^{1}+\Upsilon_{t}^{2}\right)
⋯\displaystyle\cdots
Qi\displaystyle Q^{i} ≤(4​Lf2)i−1​𝔼​[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]+2​α2​∑j=1i−1(4​Lf2)i−1−j​Υtj\displaystyle\leq\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{i-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]+2\alpha^{2}\sum_{j=1}^{i-1}\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{i-1-j}\Upsilon_{t}^{j}
≤(4​Lf2)i−1​𝔼​[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]+2​α2​∑j=1K∑l=1K(4​Lf2)K−l​Υtj.\displaystyle\leq\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{i-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]+2\alpha^{2}\sum_{j=1}^{K}\sum_{l=1}^{K}\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{K-l}\Upsilon_{t}^{j}.

When summing up, we have:

∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]=∑t=1T∑i=1KQti\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}Q^{i}_{t}
≤\displaystyle\leq ∑t=1T∑i=1K(4​Lf2)i−1​𝔼​[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]+2​α2​K​∑t=1T∑j=1K∑l=1K(4​Lf2)K−l​Υtj\displaystyle\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{i-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]+2\alpha^{2}K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{j=1}^{K}\sum_{l=1}^{K}\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{K-l}\Upsilon_{t}^{j}
≤\displaystyle\leq (∑i=1K(4​Lf2)i−1)​(∑t=1T𝔼⁡[η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2]+2​α2​K​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2])\displaystyle\left(\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(4L_{f}^{2}\right)^{i-1}\right)\left(\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\eta^{2}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]+2\alpha^{2}K\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]\right)

Thus, we complete the proof of this lemma. ∎

Next, we bound the error of gradient estimator as follows. Denote that the constants as L1=(4​K​LJ2​Lf2​K−2+8​K​Lf2​Lf2)​(∑i=1K(2​Lf2)i−1)L_{1}=\left(4KL_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}+8KL_{f}^{2}L_{f}^{2}\right)\left(\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(2L_{f}^{2}\right)^{i-1}\right), and setting α≤B1​LF22​L1\alpha\leq\frac{B_{1}L_{F}^{2}}{2L_{1}}, we can deduce:

1T​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐯t−∏i=1K∇fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]+2​K​LF2T​∑t=1T∑i=1K−1𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\displaystyle\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{v}_{t}-\prod_{i=1}^{K}\nabla f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]+\frac{2KL_{F}^{2}}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 4​K​LJ2​Lf2​K−2+8​K​LF2​Lf2α​B1​T​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮t+1i−1−𝐮ti−1‖2]\displaystyle\frac{4KL_{J}^{2}L_{f}^{2K-2}+8KL_{F}^{2}L_{f}^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t+1}^{i-1}-\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1}\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq L1α​B1​(η2​D2+2​α2​K​1T​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2])\displaystyle\frac{L_{1}}{\alpha B_{1}}\left(\eta^{2}D^{2}+2\alpha^{2}K\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]\right)
≤\displaystyle\leq L1​η2​D2α​B1+K​LF2T​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2].\displaystyle\frac{L_{1}\eta^{2}D^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}}+\frac{KL_{F}^{2}}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right].

Then, we can obtain:

1T​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐯t−∇F​(𝐱t)‖2]\displaystyle\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{v}_{t}-\nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{t})\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2T​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐯t−∏i=1K∇fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]+2​K​LF2T​∑t=1T∑i=1K−1𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\displaystyle\frac{2}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{v}_{t}-\prod_{i=1}^{K}\nabla f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]+\frac{2KL_{F}^{2}}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​L1​η2​D2α​B1\displaystyle\frac{2L_{1}\eta^{2}D^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}}

By setting I=mB1I=\frac{m}{B_{1}} and α=1/I\alpha=1/I, We have already shown that

𝔼⁡[ℱ⁡(𝐱τ)]=𝔼⁡[1T​∑t=1Tℱ⁡(𝐱t)]\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]=\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathcal{F}\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱1)−F⁡(𝐱T+1)]η​T+D⋅𝔼⁡[1T​∑t=1T‖∇F​(𝐱t)−𝐯t‖]+η​LF2​D2\displaystyle\frac{\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}_{1}\right)-F(\mathbf{x}_{T+1})\right]}{\eta T}+D\cdot\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\nabla F\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)-\mathbf{v}_{t}\right\|\right]+\eta\frac{L_{F}}{2}D^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq ΔFη​T+D​𝔼⁡[1T​∑t=1T‖∇F​(𝐱t)−𝐯t‖2]+η​LF2​D2\displaystyle\frac{\Delta_{F}}{\eta T}+D\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\nabla F\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)-\mathbf{v}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]}+\eta\frac{L_{F}}{2}D^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq ΔFη​T+D​2​L1​η2​D2α​B1+η​LF2​D2\displaystyle\frac{\Delta_{F}}{\eta T}+D\sqrt{\frac{2L_{1}\eta^{2}D^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}}}+\eta\frac{L_{F}}{2}D^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq ΔFη​T+D​2​L1​η2​m​D2B12+η​LF2​D2.\displaystyle\frac{\Delta_{F}}{\eta T}+D\sqrt{\frac{2L_{1}\eta^{2}mD^{2}}{B_{1}^{2}}}+\eta\frac{L_{F}}{2}D^{2}.

By setting η=1m1/4​T1/2,B1=1\eta=\frac{1}{m^{1/4}T^{1/2}},B_{1}=1, we can ensure 𝔼⁡[ℱ⁡(𝐱τ)]≤𝒪⁡(m1/4T1/2)\mathbb{E}\left[\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}_{\tau})\right]\leq\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{m^{1/4}}{{T}^{1/2}}\right).

In the previous analysis, we simply reduced η2​‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2≤η2​D2{\eta^{2}}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}\leq\eta^{2}D^{2}. To obtain the rate for gradient mapping, we keep this term. By setting α≤B1​LF22​L1\alpha\leq\frac{B_{1}L_{F}^{2}}{2L_{1}}, we can deduce that:

≤\displaystyle\leq L1​η2α​B1​T​∑t=1T‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2+K​LF2T​∑t=1T∑i=1K𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2].\displaystyle\frac{L_{1}\eta^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}+\frac{KL_{F}^{2}}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right].

≤\displaystyle\leq 2T​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖𝐯t−∏i=1K∇fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]+2​K​LF2T​∑t=1T∑i=1K−1𝔼⁡[‖𝐮ti−fi​(𝐮ti−1)‖2]\displaystyle\frac{2}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{v}_{t}-\prod_{i=1}^{K}\nabla f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]+\frac{2KL_{F}^{2}}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{K-1}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i}-f_{i}(\mathbf{u}_{t}^{i-1})\right\|^{2}\right]
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​L1​η2α​B1​1T​∑t=1T‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2.\displaystyle\frac{2L_{1}\eta^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}}\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|^{2}.

≤4​β​ΔFη​T+8​β2​D2N+10T​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[‖∇F​(𝐱t)−𝐯t‖2]−β22​1T​∑t=1T‖𝐳t−𝐱t‖2\displaystyle\leq\frac{4\beta\Delta_{F}}{\eta T}+\frac{8\beta^{2}D^{2}}{N}+\frac{10}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\nabla F(\mathbf{x}_{t})-\mathbf{v}_{t}\right\|^{2}\right]-\frac{\beta^{2}}{2}\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\|\mathbf{z}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\|^{2}

Appendix J Proof of Theorem 10

Note that in the previous analysis, we have proved that

1T​∑t=1T𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱t)]−F⋆≤\displaystyle\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right]-F_{\star}\leq (𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱1)]−F⋆)η​T+D​1T​∑t=1T𝔼​‖∇F​(𝐱t)−𝐯t‖2+η​LF​D22\displaystyle\frac{\left(\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}_{1}\right)\right]-F_{\star}\right)}{\eta T}+D\sqrt{\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\mathbb{E}\left\|\nabla F\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)-\mathbf{v}_{t}\right\|^{2}}+\eta\frac{L_{F}D^{2}}{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq (𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱1)]−F⋆)η​T+D​2​L1​D2​η2α​B1+η​LF​D22.\displaystyle\frac{\left(\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}_{1}\right)\right]-F_{\star}\right)}{\eta T}+D\sqrt{\frac{2L_{1}D^{2}\eta^{2}}{\alpha B_{1}}}+\eta\frac{L_{F}D^{2}}{2}.

Next, we denote 𝐱s\mathbf{x}^{s} as the output of Algorithm 3 for the stage ss. Then, we have:

Set ϵs=(12)s−1\epsilon_{s}=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{s-1}, ηs≤ϵs3​LF​D2,B1s≥D2​18​L1​n​ηsϵs\eta_{s}\leq\frac{\epsilon_{s}}{3L_{F}D^{2}},B_{1}^{s}\geq D^{2}\sqrt{18L_{1}n}\frac{\eta_{s}}{\epsilon_{s}}, Ts≥6+3​ΔFηsT_{s}\geq\frac{6+3\Delta_{F}}{\eta_{s}}. We can guarantee that 𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱s)−F⋆]≤ϵs\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}^{s}\right)-F_{\star}\right]\leq\epsilon_{s}. We will use Induction to give the proof:

Proof.

When s=1s=1, we have:

𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱1)−F⋆]\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}^{1}\right)-F_{\star}\right] ≤ΔFη1​T1+D2​2​L1​η12α1​B11+η1​LF​D22≤ϵ1=1\displaystyle\leq\frac{\Delta_{F}}{\eta_{1}T_{1}}+D^{2}\sqrt{\frac{2L_{1}\eta_{1}^{2}}{\alpha_{1}B_{1}^{1}}}+\eta_{1}\frac{L_{F}D^{2}}{2}\leq\epsilon_{1}=1

Assume that 𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱s)−F⋆]≤ϵs\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}^{s}\right)-F_{\star}\right]\leq\epsilon_{s}, we would prove that it holds for stage s+1s+1 as well.

𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱s+1)−F⋆]\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}^{s+1}\right)-F_{\star}\right] ≤ϵsηs+1​Ts+1+D2​2​L1​ηs+12αs+1​B1s+1+ηs+1​LF​D22≤ϵs/2=ϵs+1\displaystyle\leq\frac{\epsilon_{s}}{\eta_{s+1}T_{s+1}}+D^{2}\sqrt{\frac{2L_{1}\eta_{s+1}^{2}}{\alpha_{s+1}B_{1}^{s+1}}}+\eta_{s+1}\frac{L_{F}D^{2}}{2}\leq\epsilon_{s}/2=\epsilon_{s+1}

So we prove 𝔼⁡[F⁡(𝐱s)−F⋆]≤(12)s−1\mathbb{E}\left[F\left(\mathbf{x}^{s}\right)-F_{\star}\right]\leq\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{s-1} with ηs≤ϵs3​LF​D2,B1s≥D2​18​L1​m​ηsϵs\eta_{s}\leq\frac{\epsilon_{s}}{3L_{F}D^{2}},B_{1}^{s}\geq D^{2}\sqrt{18L_{1}m}\frac{\eta_{s}}{\epsilon_{s}}, Ts≥6+3​ΔFηsT_{s}\geq\frac{6+3\Delta_{F}}{\eta_{s}}.
